text:
maya (FinOps): FYI — noticed a $6,432.17 GPU invoice line this morning on account 'platform-prod' with no team tag. digging. :eyes:

billing-bot: New invoice posted: INV-2026-03-23 total $6,432.17 (line: gpu-us-west1).

maya (FinOps): quick query I ran:
SELECT COALESCE(team,'untagged') AS team, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM cloud_billing_usage
WHERE service = 'gpu' AND usage_date = '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY team;

result:
team,cost
platform,6432.17
untagged,0.00

lee (Finance): @sam can you confirm whether this is legitimately platform or a mis-tag? need to reassign before month close if wrong.

sam (Platform): checking. 02:10-02:30 UTC shows heavy GPU from shared pool used by nightly indexer. deployment logged indexer:v3.2.1 at 02:15 and didn't pass billing metadata.

sam (Platform): that indexer is Search-owned. deploy job likely regressed and omitted --billing-team. @anna any context?

anna (Search): yep that was our rollout to sidecar workers last week. pipeline changed a param name and we forgot to set the billing flag. my bad.

maya (FinOps): per FinOps rules, reallocations <= $10k can be approved by finance with owner confirmation + ledger PR. @anna confirm ownership and approve reassign to GL code 4005-search-research?

anna (Search): I confirm and approve reassign to 4005-search-research. I'll open JIRA BILL-4321 and attach invoice and notes.

lee (Finance): good. maya, please create ledger PR once JIRA exists so we can update month-end.

maya (FinOps): will do. also planning a 7-day backfill to catch any missed indexer runs and will post CSV of candidates by EOD.

sam (Platform): mitigation: pushing one-line fix to deploy template to require billing tag. snippet:
# ensure billing tag env is set
export BILLING_TEAM=${BILLING_TEAM:-search}
sed -i 's/--billing-team=""/--billing-team="$BILLING_TEAM"/' ci/deploy-indexer.sh
rolled out to CI; added unit test to fail when BILLING_TEAM unset.

mike (EngOps): suggest tightening untagged GPU alert. prod threshold currently $2k/day; propose $750/day for prod pools and keep sandbox at $2k.

lee (Finance): agree. lower prod threshold to $750/day. first alert -> notify FinOps + owner pager.

maya (FinOps): @billing-bot create alert 'untagged_gpu_daily_v2' threshold $750 scoped to prod gpu pools.

billing-bot: Alert created: unlabeled_gpu_daily_v2; scope=prod-gpu-pools; threshold=$750/day; notify=[maya (FinOps), lee (Finance), oncall-eng].

anna (Search): JIRA BILL-4321 posted with invoice link and my approval. adding ledger PR tracker.

maya (FinOps): opened ledger PR and queued backfill. will post candidate CSV and close once merged. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
